metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the first lift, the second, the bed over the hall, and a word about the lute-string.

yesterday: You are flat on the bed over the hall. The back is as the lift left it.
Anne was unkind at the plot and kind on the bed. The two sentences were different, and both were hers.
The six pairs are still the walk that was set for after the frame.
The orchard sheet is in the house, as it was.
The ale stayed with the men who wanted it. The cousin was paying it.
